findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_board, create_board, update_board, check_board_layout, export_board · Private data: submit_feedback, list_boards, get_board, save_board_to_account, create_board, get_generation, export_board · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: create_board, update_board, delete_board, export_board.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_board, create_board, update_board, check_board_layout, export_board · Private data: submit_feedback, list_boards, get_board, save_board_to_account, create_board, get_generation, export_board · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: create_board, update_board, delete_board, export_board

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
